query: List ALL 7 first-level administrative divisions of Pakistan (Punjab; Islamabad; Sindh; Azad Jammu and Kashmir; Balochistan; Khyber Pakhtunkhwa; Gilgit-Baltistan). For each give: the executive office title in English and the local language, how that office is filled, its term length, the CURRENT officeholder as of 2026-11-14 (full name, party name and acronym, coalition, term start and end, whether acting/interim) with source URLs, and the division's legislature (English and local name, number of seats, how filled). Explain in special_status_note any division whose governance differs from the others (for example a capital district).

divisions.name: Islamabad
divisions.special_status_note: Federally administered capital territory, not a province: the federally appointed Chief Commissioner administers it under the Interior Division. It has no territorial legislature or chief minister; Pakistan’s Parliament legislates for the territory.

divisions.name: Azad Jammu and Kashmir

officeholder.coalition: PML-N and allied members (allies not individually confirmed)

divisions.legislature_name_en: Azad Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly
divisions.special_status_note: Self-governing territory under its 1974 Interim Constitution, not a Pakistani province. Its executive is called Prime Minister; 12 of the 45 general assembly seats represent refugees resident in Pakistan. Seven constituency elections had been postponed at the August 2026 prime-ministerial vote.
divisions.executive_title_local: وزیرِ اعظم آزاد جموں و کشمیر
divisions.legislature_name_local: آزاد جموں و کشمیر قانون ساز اسمبلی

officeholder.coalition: PPP–PML-N–Balochistan Awami Party (BAP) coalition formed in 2024

divisions.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa

officeholder.coalition: PTI-backed independent legislators (not a confirmed formal multi-party coalition)

divisions.special_status_note: Governor’s rule and emergency imposed on 2026-10-11: Sohail Afridi remains the listed but non-functional Chief Minister, reportedly in preventive custody, while Governor Faisal Karim Kundi exercises provincial executive powers. This is not an acting-chief-minister appointment.

divisions.name: Gilgit-Baltistan

officeholder.coalition: PPP-led coalition supported by Istehkam-e-Pakistan Party (IPP), with a PPP–PML-N power-sharing arrangement

divisions.special_status_note: Federally administered, self-governing territory under the Gilgit-Baltistan Order 2018, not a constitutionally established Pakistani province. Its assembly has 24 directly elected and nine indirectly elected reserved seats.
